question: Should OpenClaw add execute-on-parse tool dispatch, and if so should it be a new opt-in toolExecution mode or a change to current parallel semantics?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes core runtime behavior and user-visible ordering/security semantics rather than repairing a narrowly broken existing contract.

options.title: Design opt-in core mode
options.body: Keep this issue open and require an owner design for an execute-on-parse path with transcript, hook, approval, cancellation, and ordering tests.

options.title: Backlog performance idea
options.body: Keep the request open as a performance backlog item until maintainers decide the API and compatibility policy.

options.title: Reject early execution
options.body: Close or defer the request if current post-stream parallel batching is the only concurrency model maintainers want to support.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in core mode
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require an owner design for an execute-on-parse path with transcript, hook, approval, cancellation, and ordering tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the agent-core and OpenAI stream/runtime surfaces this design would touch.
